Pre-order & Schedule

Group Order Splitting
One cart, everyone adds their items via link. Single checkout, automatic bill splitting.

Accessible Routes

Smart Trash Tracking
Gamified waste tracking. Log your tray disposal, earn eco-points, see campus waste stats live.

Staff Tools
Built for Faculty & Staff
⚡
Priority Lane

Monthly Meal Ledger
Download your complete monthly meal history, expense reports, and receipts for reimbursement.

Staff Meal Wallet
Pre-load your meal wallet, use subsidized pricing, and get automatic deductions from your payroll.

Bulk Booking
Book meals for department meetings, faculty events, or student workshops in one streamlined flow.
📢
Notice Board Admin
Post announcements, cafeteria closures, and event specials directly to the student-facing notice board.

Nutrition Analytics
View aggregate campus nutrition data, peak ordering times, and suggest menu improvements.
